name: Boon of Bloodshed

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: Reference-only: A visible enemy reaching 0 HP grants Advantage on your next attack before your next turn ends. Once per turn while Bloodied, an attack can add PB damage of its type.
